name: idle
promptSection: A01 · `idle`: relaxed stance, hands in pockets (breathing loop) (CORE)
poses: 1. KEY POSE. Relaxed, tall stance: left (lead) foot forward with the toes pointing right, right foot back and turned out 45 degrees, feet about shoulder-width, knees bent about 20 degrees, weight mostly on the back (right) leg, hips slightly cocked. Torso turned about 35 degrees toward the viewer with a lazy slouch: shoulders loose and a little rounded, head forward and tilted slightly down as if looking down at a shorter opponent. BOTH HANDS IN HIS TROUSER POCKETS under the jacket hem, elbows hanging loosely out from his sides. Face: lazy, confident one-sided smile. The white hair crown stands up above the black blindfold band.
2. Inhale: chest and shoulders rise very slightly. Hair tips not moved yet (lag). Face: lazy smile.
3. Top of the breath, slightly higher; hair tips lift slightly. Face: lazy smile.
4. Hold the top; the jacket hem drifts slightly. Face: lazy smile.
5. Exhale, halfway down. Face: lazy smile.
6. Same height as frame 1. Face: lazy smile.
7. Lowest point: knees bend a little more, shoulders drop slightly, the head bobs slightly; hair tips and the jacket hem settle. Face: lazy smile.
8. Rising back toward frame 1 (flows straight into frame 1). Face: lazy smile.
description: ANIMATION: "idle", relaxed fighting stance with both hands in his pockets (breathing loop). 8 frames in total, numbered 1 to 8 from left to right; this image is PART A of 2 and shows only poses 1 to 4. It loops: the last frame must flow smoothly back into the first.

name: run
poses: 1. Contact: left foot reaching forward, ball of the foot touching down well ahead of the hips; right leg extended back, toes pushing off; right arm swung forward, left arm back. Face: lazy smile.
2. Down: weight on the left leg, knee bent deepest, body at its lowest; right heel lifting behind.
3. Passing: left leg under the hips, right knee swinging forward past it; body rising.
4. Flight: both feet off the ground; right knee forward and up, left leg extended straight back; body at its highest; longest stride.
5. Contact (like frame 1 with the legs and arms swapped): right foot reaching forward, left leg back; left arm forward, right arm back. Face: lazy smile.
6. Down: weight on the right leg, knee bent deepest, body at its lowest.
7. Passing: left knee swinging forward past the right leg; body rising.
8. Flight: left knee forward and up, right leg extended back; body at its highest (flows into frame 1).
description: ANIMATION: "run", easy long-striding athletic run. 8 frames in total, numbered 1 to 8 from left to right; this image is PART A of 2 and shows only poses 1 to 4. It loops: the last frame must flow smoothly back into the first.

name: dash
poses: 1. Low fast forward glide with BOTH HANDS STILL IN HIS POCKETS: torso leaning about 45 degrees forward, chin up, left knee bent under the chest, right leg extended straight back with the toes dragging, elbows tucked back. Face: lazy smile. Hair tips and the jacket hem streaming back hard.
2. Stride slightly wider (left foot further forward, right foot further back); the jacket hem fluttering differently.
description: ANIMATION: "dash", low fast forward glide with his hands in his pockets. 2 frames, left to right. It loops: the last frame must flow smoothly back into the first.

name: backDash
poses: 1. Push-off backward: knees bent, weight on the ball of the left (front) foot pushing back; torso upright leaning back slightly; the hands come out of the pockets, open, loosely in front of the chest. Face: lazy smile.
2. In the air: both feet off the ground, knees tucked, torso leaning back, arms forward for balance; hair tips and the jacket hem whipping FORWARD (to the right).
3. Landing on the ball of the right (back) foot, the left foot about to touch, legs nearly extended, knees starting to absorb; hands drifting back toward the pockets. Face: lazy smile.
description: ANIMATION: "backDash", quick hop backward. 3 frames, left to right.

name: superDash
poses: 1. Flying to the right like a missile, the body angled about 30 degrees UPWARD (head and leading hand higher, hips lower), head locked on the target. RIGHT ARM thrust forward along the flight line with an OPEN PALM leading (heel of the palm forward, fingers up); the LEFT HAND IN HIS POCKET. KNEES BENT SHARPLY as if kneeling in the air: thighs angled down and a little forward from the hips, shins folded back so the feet trail behind; the knees are the lowest point, under the middle of the shape; toes pointed. Face: focused, smile corner. Hair crown flattened back, the jacket hem streaming straight back.
2. Knees bent slightly more and slightly apart; the jacket hem fluttering differently.
description: ANIMATION: "superDash", homing super dash, flying palm first. 2 frames, left to right. It loops: the last frame must flow smoothly back into the first.

name: jumpSquat
poses: 1. Deep crouch right before jumping: knees bent sharply, left foot forward, torso leaning forward; the RIGHT ARM swung down and back with an open hand, the LEFT HAND IN HIS POCKET; head up looking forward and up; the hair crown squashed slightly, the jacket hem pooled over the thighs. Face: lazy smile.
description: ANIMATION: "jumpSquat", pre-jump crouch. 1 frame.

name: jumpUp
poses: 1. Rising: knees tucked high (left knee near the chest, right knee a little lower), torso upright; the RIGHT ARM raised up and forward with an open hand at about head height in front of his face (never above the top of his hair); the LEFT HAND IN HIS POCKET; head tilted slightly up. Face: lazy smile. Hair tips and the jacket hem dragged downward by the upward motion.
2. Knees and the right arm slightly lower; the jacket hem fluttering differently.
description: ANIMATION: "jumpUp", rising in the air. 2 frames, left to right. It loops: the last frame must flow smoothly back into the first.

name: jumpFall
poses: 1. Falling: legs extending down, the left leg slightly forward and bent, the right leg slightly back and bent, toes pointed down; the RIGHT ARM out forward for balance with an open hand below head height; the LEFT HAND IN HIS POCKET; head tilted down toward the right. Face: lazy smile. Hair tips lifted, the jacket hem lifted and flared.
2. The right arm slightly higher; hair tips and hem fluttering differently.
description: ANIMATION: "jumpFall", falling. 2 frames, left to right. It loops: the last frame must flow smoothly back into the first.

name: land
poses: 1. Impact crouch: knees deeply bent, torso leaning forward, the right arm out forward and down for balance, the left hand in his pocket; the hair crown squashed slightly, the jacket hem pooled over the thighs. Face: lazy smile.
2. Rising halfway back to the stance, the right hand drifting toward its pocket. Face: lazy smile.
description: ANIMATION: "land", landing. 2 frames, left to right.

name: light1
promptSection: A03 · `light1`: palm jab with the L (lead) hand (CORE)
poses: 1. Anticipation: the left hand slides out of the pocket, flattening into an open palm, and pulls back to the chest; shoulders turn slightly away. The right hand stays in its pocket. Face: focused, mouth a calm line.
2. The left palm launches, elbow half extended, shoulders start rotating forward. Face: focused.

3. IMPACT: left arm FULLY EXTENDED horizontally to the right at the height of a shorter opponent's face (about his own chin-to-collar height), an open palm with the fingers pointing up and the HEEL OF THE PALM leading. No step forward: his weight stays back and the long arm does the work. The right hand still in its pocket. SMEAR: a short solid tapered streak behind the palm in navy-sleeve and skin colors (hard pixels, no blur). Face: focused, faint smile.
4. Same full extension without the smear, the palm a touch further; hair tips flick forward, the sleeve ripples. Face: focused.
5. Palm retracting halfway, elbow bending. Face: focused.
6. Left hand back at the hip, sliding toward the pocket. Face: lazy smile.
7. Back in the relaxed stance with both hands in the pockets (same as idle frame 1). Face: lazy smile.
description: ANIMATION: "light1", palm jab with the left (lead) hand; his right hand stays in its pocket. 7 frames in total, numbered 1 to 7 from left to right; this image is PART A of 2 and shows only poses 1 to 4. Poses 3 and 4 are the HIT frames: the striking palm is fully extended toward the right and is the right-most part of the character; his head, hair, free hand and jacket hem stay behind it.

name: light2
promptSection: A04 · `light2`: rear palm strike with the R (near) hand (CORE)
poses: 1. Hips coil, torso twists back toward the viewer; both hands out of the pockets: the right palm cocked back beside the right shoulder, the left hand open in front of the chest; weight on the right leg. Face: focused.
2. Hips and shoulders rotate forward, the right palm driving forward past the chin. Face: focused.

3. IMPACT: right arm FULLY EXTENDED horizontally to the right at the height of a shorter opponent's chin, the palm heel forward with the fingers up, crossing in front of his body (fully visible); torso rotated almost to profile, right heel lifted, pivoting on the ball of the foot; left hand open in front of the chest. SMEAR: a solid streak trailing behind the right palm (no blur). Face: focused, a thin grin.
4. Same extension without the smear, the palm a touch further. Face: thin grin.
5. Right palm retracting, torso unwinding. Face: focused.
6. Right hand back at the hip; the left hand dropping toward its pocket. Face: lazy smile.
7. Back in the relaxed stance with both hands in the pockets (same as idle frame 1). Face: lazy smile.
description: ANIMATION: "light2", palm strike with the right (rear, near) hand. 7 frames in total, numbered 1 to 7 from left to right; this image is PART A of 2 and shows only poses 1 to 4. Poses 3 and 4 are the HIT frames: the striking palm is fully extended toward the right and is the right-most part of the character; his head, hair, free hand and jacket hem stay behind it.

name: light3
promptSection: A05 · `light3`: push kick to the stomach with the R (near) leg, hands in pockets (CORE)
poses: 1. Weight shifts onto the left (front) leg; the right knee starts to lift, the jacket's side slit opening around the thigh. Both hands in the pockets. Face: focused.
2. Right knee chambered high (thigh horizontal, shin hanging down), torso leaning back slightly. Both hands in the pockets.

3. IMPACT: right leg FULLY EXTENDED straight forward to the right at the height of a shorter opponent's stomach (about his own hip height): the sole and heel push forward, toes pulled back. Torso leans back slightly. The supporting left leg is straight with the whole foot flat on the ground (he does NOT rise onto his toes). Both hands stay in his pockets. The jacket hem stays behind the knee. SMEAR: a solid arc from the chambered knee to the foot in trouser navy and shoe black (no blur). Face: focused, faint smile.
4. Same extension without the smear, the foot a touch further. Face: faint smile.
5. Knee re-chambers, shin folding back.
6. Right foot sets down behind him.
7. Back in the relaxed stance (same as idle frame 1). Face: lazy smile.
description: ANIMATION: "light3", front push kick to the stomach with the right (near) leg, both hands staying in his pockets. 7 frames in total, numbered 1 to 7 from left to right; this image is PART A of 2 and shows only poses 1 to 4. Poses 3 and 4 are the HIT frames: the striking foot is fully extended toward the right and is the right-most part of the character; his head, hair, free hand and jacket hem stay behind it.

name: light4
promptSection: A06 · `light4`: spinning roundhouse finisher with the R leg (CORE)
poses: 1. Wind-up: the hands come out of the pockets, torso twists toward the viewer, arms coil in, knees bend. Face: grin.

2. Spinning on the left foot: his BACK now faces the viewer (the back of the tall collar, the jacket back and the blindfold's wraps at the back of his head are visible); right leg lifting; head turning to look over his shoulder at the target.
3. Back to the viewer, side-on: right knee chambered high and turned over (hip rolled); head spotting the target on the right; the jacket hem flares out with the spin.

4. IMPACT: right leg FULLY EXTENDED high and horizontal to the right, the shin and instep striking at the height of a shorter opponent's head (about his own shoulder height, so he barely leans); torso leaning back slightly, the left foot flat on the ground, arms flung out below head height. SMEAR: a big solid crescent from behind and below up to the foot (no blur). Face: grin with teeth.
5. Same extension without the smear; hair tips and the jacket hem whipping forward. Face: grin.
6. Leg dropping, the rotation following through. Face: lazy smile.
7. Right foot sets down, regaining the stance.
8. Back in the relaxed stance with both hands in the pockets (same as idle frame 1). Face: lazy smile.
description: ANIMATION: "light4", spinning roundhouse finisher with the right leg. 8 frames in total, numbered 1 to 8 from left to right; this image is PART A of 2 and shows only poses 1 to 5. Poses 4 and 5 are the HIT frames: the striking foot is fully extended toward the right and is the right-most part of the character; his head, hair, free hand and jacket hem stay behind it.

name: heavy
promptSection: A07 · `heavy`: rising elbow launcher with the R (near) elbow (CORE)
poses: 1. Crouch starts: the hands come out of the pockets, knees bend, torso leans forward slightly, the right arm folds tight with the fist at the right collarbone and the elbow pointing down. Face: focused.
2. Deepest crouch: the right elbow low in front of his stomach, forearm folded up; left hand open forward, guarding; head down over the target; the jacket hem pooled over the thighs. Face: focused.
3. Legs explode upward; the right elbow starts rising in front of his stomach and chest. Face: focused.

4. IMPACT: rising, heels off the ground but the knees still bent; the right ELBOW drives UP AND FORWARD in front of him through the height of a shorter opponent's chin, the right fist beside his right ear; torso leaning back slightly, left arm pulled down to his side. SMEAR: a solid crescent along the elbow's path (no blur). Face: grin with teeth.

5. Peak, fully in the air, knees bent and feet hanging with pointed toes: the right elbow points STRAIGHT UP in front of his face, its tip level with the top of his hair and never above it; hair tips dragged down, jacket hem lifted. Face: grin.
6. Descending, the arm unfolding down, knees bending. Face: focused.
7. Landing crouch. Face: lazy smile.
8. Back in the relaxed stance with both hands in the pockets (same as idle frame 1). Face: lazy smile.
description: ANIMATION: "heavy", rising elbow launcher with the right (near) elbow. 8 frames in total, numbered 1 to 8 from left to right; this image is PART A of 2 and shows only poses 1 to 5. Poses 4 and 5 are the HIT frames: the right ELBOW leads (the forearm stays folded, the fist beside his ear) and is the right-most and highest part of his arm; nothing rises above the top of his hair.

name: airLight1
promptSection: A08 · `airLight1`: mid-air palm jab with the L hand (CORE)
poses: 1. Air pose, the left palm pulled back to the chest, shoulders coiled. Face: focused.

2. IMPACT: left arm FULLY EXTENDED horizontally to the right at his own lower-chest height, an open palm with the fingers up and the heel of the palm leading; torso leaning forward slightly. SMEAR: a solid tapered streak behind the palm (no blur). Face: focused.
3. Same extension without the smear. Face: focused.
4. Palm pulling back. Face: focused.
5. Air pose. Face: lazy smile.
description: ANIMATION: "airLight1", mid-air palm jab with the left hand. 5 frames, left to right. Poses 2 and 3 are the HIT frames: the striking palm is fully extended toward the right and is the right-most part of the character; his head, hair, free hand and jacket hem stay behind it.

name: airLight2
promptSection: A27 · `airLight2`: mid-air front kick with the R leg
poses: 1. Right knee chambered up to the chest. Face: focused.

2. IMPACT: right leg extends STRAIGHT FORWARD to the right, angled slightly down, at his own hip height, sole first; torso leans back slightly, the right arm out behind for balance, the left leg hanging as the lowest point. SMEAR: a solid arc to the foot (no blur). Face: focused.
3. Same extension without the smear. Face: focused.
4. Knee re-chambers. Face: focused.
5. Air pose. Face: lazy smile.
description: ANIMATION: "airLight2", mid-air front kick with the right leg. 5 frames, left to right. Poses 2 and 3 are the HIT frames: the striking foot is fully extended toward the right and is the right-most part of the character; his head, hair, free hand and jacket hem stay behind it.

name: airLight3
promptSection: A28 · `airLight3`: mid-air spinning heel kick with the L leg
poses: 1. Body twists away (his back toward the viewer: the back of the collar and the blindfold's wraps visible), left knee chambered. Face: focused.
2. Spinning: hips turn over, head spots the target on the right, the jacket hem flaring.

3. IMPACT: left leg FULLY EXTENDED forward to the right, heel leading, at his own waist height; body leaning back, right knee tucked, arms flung (right back, left forward, below head height). SMEAR: a big solid crescent (no blur). Face: grin.
4. Same extension without the smear. Face: grin.
5. Leg folding back in. Face: focused.
6. Air pose. Face: lazy smile.
description: ANIMATION: "airLight3", mid-air spinning heel kick with the left leg. 6 frames in total, numbered 1 to 6 from left to right; this image is PART A of 2 and shows only poses 1 to 4. Poses 3 and 4 are the HIT frames: the striking heel is fully extended toward the right and is the right-most part of the character; his head, hair, free hand and jacket hem stay behind it.

name: airHeavy
poses: 1. Both hands clasped together (fingers interlocked) raised behind his head, elbows bent up and back; torso arching back, knees tucked. Face: grin.
2. Wind-up peak: arched further back, the clasped hands behind his head at the height of the top of his hair and never above it. Face: grin.

3. IMPACT: torso whips forward, both straight arms swing DOWN AND FORWARD, the clasped hands in front of and below his chest on the right; knees bent with the feet hanging below the hands. SMEAR: a large solid crescent from overhead down to the hands (no blur). Face: grin with teeth.
4. Same smash pose without the smear, the hands slightly lower; hair tips whipping down. Face: focused.
5. Arms rising, body uncurling. Face: focused.
6. Air pose: torso upright, both hands open in a loose guard at chest height, left knee forward and up, right leg hanging with pointed toes. Face: lazy smile.
description: ANIMATION: "airHeavy", two-handed hammer spike. 6 frames in total, numbered 1 to 6 from left to right; this image is PART A of 2 and shows only poses 1 to 4. Poses 3 and 4 are the HIT frames. Pose 3: both straight arms smash the clasped hands DOWN AND FORWARD, in front of and below his chest; the hands are the right-most part of his arms, and his feet stay lower than the hands. Pose 4: the same smash with the hands slightly lower, still in front of and below his chest and above his feet.

name: guard
poses: 1. A casual high block: both forearms raised in front of his face and upper chest, CROSSED AT THE WRISTS, hands open with the palms facing out, fingers loose, elbows down; chin tucked, body leaning back slightly, knees bent more than in the stance, weight back, left foot forward. Face: focused, unbothered.
2. Identical but the body slightly lower (breathing); hair tips slightly shifted. Face: focused.
description: ANIMATION: "guard", casual crossed-wrist block. 2 frames, left to right. It loops: the last frame must flow smoothly back into the first.

name: block
poses: 1. Pushed back by a blocked hit: whole body leaning back slightly and slid back (right heel digging in), forearms still crossed at the wrists but jarred upward. Face: mouth tight, teeth showing (annoyed). Hair tips and the jacket hem blown back to the left.
2. Settling back into the guard, knees a little straighter than in the guard. Face: focused.
description: ANIMATION: "block", pushed back while blocking. 2 frames, left to right.

name: hurtHigh
poses: 1. Hit in the face: head snapped back with the chin up, torso arched back, both arms flung back and out with open hands, one foot slipping. The blindfold stays on. Face: teeth gritted, mouth twisted in pain. Hair tips and jacket hem whipping forward, the hair crown jolted.
2. About a third recovered: head coming down, arms swinging back in. Face: pain.
3. Mostly recovered, still wincing, arms returning toward guard. Face: teeth gritted.
description: ANIMATION: "hurtHigh", hit in the face. 3 frames, left to right.

name: hurtLow
poses: 1. Hit in the stomach: doubled over, torso bent forward, head down, both arms clutching his stomach, knees bent. Face: mouth open, teeth gritted. The hair crown swinging forward and down. Blindfold on.
2. About a third recovered. Face: pain.
3. Rising, wincing, one hand still on his stomach. Face: teeth gritted.
description: ANIMATION: "hurtLow", hit in the stomach. 3 frames, left to right.

name: launched
poses: 1. Knocked flying backward to the left by a big hit from the right. His body is tilted about 60 degrees back from upright and arched like a drawn bow with the belly up: his HIPS are the lowest point, near the middle of the pose; head and shoulders rise to the upper left; long legs bent and trailing forward to the right at about hip height; arms flung up and back with the elbows bent (not fully stretched). Face: mouth open in pain. Hair tips and jacket hem whipping to the right.
2. Arms and legs in slightly different flailing positions. Face: same.
description: ANIMATION: "launched", knocked flying backward. 2 frames, left to right. It loops: the last frame must flow smoothly back into the first.

name: spin
poses: 1. Tumbling head over heels backward through the air after a big hit, balled up with knees to his chest and arms bent in, tilted back 30 degrees, head at the upper left. Face: teeth gritted. Blindfold on.
2. Rotated 120 degrees: head pointing down-left.
3. Upside down: head at the bottom.
4. Rotated 300 degrees: head at the right, coming back upright.
description: ANIMATION: "spin", tumbling backward. 4 frames, left to right. It loops: the last frame must flow smoothly back into the first.

name: airRecover
poses: 1. Tucked, tilted back about 60 degrees, knees to the chest. Face: mouth flat, regaining control.
2. Upside down, fully tucked.
3. Almost upright, unfolding: legs extending down, arms out for balance. Face: lazy smile.
description: ANIMATION: "airRecover", mid-air backflip recovery. 3 frames, left to right.

name: down
promptSection: A13 · `down`: slammed down, then lying on the back (CORE)
poses: 1. His back slams flat onto the ground from the shoulders to the hips (head on the LEFT), knees bent and lifted toward the upper right by the bounce, arms flung out to the sides. Face: mouth open. The hair crown splashing out to the left. The blindfold stays on.
2. Lying flat on his back, head on the LEFT and feet on the RIGHT, arms out at his sides (not above his head), one knee slightly bent. Face: grimacing. The jacket hem splayed.
description: ANIMATION: "down", slammed into the ground, then lying on his back. 2 frames, left to right.

name: getup
poses: 1. Lying on his back (head on the LEFT), knees pulled to his chest, palms planted beside his head with the fingers toward the shoulders. Face: mouth flat.
2. Legs kicking up and over toward the upper right, rolling onto his shoulders, hands pushing off. Face: focused.
3. Springing up into the air, torso tilted back, legs folding under him, arms out. Face: focused.
4. Landing in a crouch facing right, hands going toward his pockets. Face: focused.
5. His relaxed stance with both hands in the pockets (left foot forward, same as idle frame 1). Face: lazy smile.
description: ANIMATION: "getup", kip-up from lying on his back to standing. 5 frames, left to right.

name: charge
poses: 1. Calm power-up: wide stance with the feet well apart and the knees bent, torso upright, arms held slightly out from his sides and down, palms open facing the floor, fingers spread; head tilted slightly back. Face: calm lazy smile (no shouting). Hair tips and the jacket hem blown upward by a rising wind, sleeves fluttering. Whole body shifted slightly left.
2. Same, shifted slightly right; hair tips in a new flicker shape.
3. Shifted slightly left; palms slightly higher.
4. Shifted slightly right; the jacket hem in a new flicker shape.
description: ANIMATION: "charge", calm power-up. 4 frames, left to right. It loops: the last frame must flow smoothly back into the first.

name: throw
promptSection: A33 · `throw`: REVERSAL: RED in mid-air (finger flick)
poses: 1. Wind-up in mid-air: torso upright leaning back slightly; the RIGHT hand raised to his chest with the INDEX FINGER UP and the MIDDLE FINGER COCKED AGAINST THE THUMB (a flick about to snap). Face: focused.

2. FLICK: the right arm snaps forward and slightly down toward the right, elbow slightly bent, the index finger pointing at the target and the middle finger flicked forward off the thumb; torso leaning forward, legs trailing back and down. Face: mouth open, naming the technique. (Optional: a short solid streak along the hand's path.)
3. Recoil: the right arm kicks up and back with an open hand (below head height), the body drifting back; hair tips and the jacket hem blown back to the left. Face: focused.
4. Air pose, the right hand lowering. Face: lazy smile.
description: ANIMATION: "throw", REVERSAL: RED fired in mid-air with a finger flick. 4 frames, left to right. Pose 2 is the RELEASE frame: the right fingertips point at the target and are the right-most part of his arm.

name: beamCharge
poses: 1. Wide grounded stance (left foot forward, knees bent), torso upright with the chest open to the viewer. BOTH ARMS HELD OUT APART at chest height, elbows slightly bent, palms up, fingers slightly curled as if each hand cradles an invisible orb: the left hand forward on the right side of the image, the right hand back on the left side of the image, both at the same height. The hands are open and EMPTY. Head turned toward the right. Face: focused, calm mouth. Hair tips and the jacket hem blown upward by a rising wind.
2. A tiny tremble: both hands slightly closer together; hair tips flicker.
3. Tremble back; fingers flex slightly (flows into frame 1).
description: ANIMATION: "beamCharge", charging the HOLLOW PURPLE, hands apart. 3 frames, left to right. It loops: the last frame must flow smoothly back into the first.

name: beamFire
poses: 1. Deep lunge to the right: left leg forward and bent, right leg straight back, torso leaning forward slightly. RIGHT ARM THRUST STRAIGHT FORWARD to the right as an OPEN PALM (fingers up, palm facing right) at his own stomach height, the heel of the palm the right-most point of the character; the left hand pulled back to his left hip, open. Head behind the right shoulder. Face: mouth open, naming the technique. Hair tips, jacket hem and sleeves blown back to the left by the recoil.
2. Recoil: the whole body slightly back; hair tips flicker.
3. Pushing forward again, slightly forward (flows into frame 1).
description: ANIMATION: "beamFire", firing the HOLLOW PURPLE with a palm thrust. 3 frames, left to right. It loops: the last frame must flow smoothly back into the first.

name: vanish
poses: 1. Quick crouch: body squashed slightly, torso leaning forward, BOTH HANDS IN HIS POCKETS. Face: focused.

2. High-speed blur: the body stretched THINNER (not taller), up on the balls of his feet with the knees still slightly bent, hands in his pockets, hair tips and the jacket hem streaming up; the lower half broken into 3 or 4 solid horizontal slices shifted sideways by small different amounts (an afterimage effect made of solid shapes in his own colors, no transparency, no blur). Face: focused.
description: ANIMATION: "vanish", high-speed teleport. 2 frames, left to right.

name: stagger
poses: 1. Dizzy: standing almost upright on wobbly knees, arms hanging loose out of the pockets, head lolling, leaning to the right. Face: mouth slack and slightly open. Blindfold on, the hair crown tilted.
2. Centered and upright. Face: slack.
3. Leaning to the left. Face: slack.
4. Centered. Face: slack.
description: ANIMATION: "stagger", dizzy stagger. 4 frames, left to right. It loops: the last frame must flow smoothly back into the first.

name: ko
poses: 1. Knocked out, lying flat on his back with his head on the LEFT and feet on the RIGHT, completely limp, arms splayed at his sides, one knee only slightly bent. Face: mouth slightly open, slack. The blindfold still on, the hair spread on the ground, the jacket hem splayed.
description: ANIMATION: "ko", knocked out. 1 frame.

name: special
poses: 1. The right hand slides out of the pocket and rises to his chest; weight settles back; the left hand stays in its pocket. Face: lazy smile.
2. The right arm extends forward; the INDEX AND MIDDLE FINGERS are extended together, the other fingers curled and the thumb tucked (a two-finger sign). Face: focused.
3. Right arm fully extended forward at his chest height, elbow almost straight, the two fingertips pointing straight at the target on the right. Face: focused.

4. Release: the wrist snaps a quarter-turn so the palm faces up, the two fingers still pointing forward; hair tips and the jacket hem pulled slightly FORWARD (to the right), toward an invisible pull. Face: focused.
5. Same, the two fingers slightly crooked. Face: focused.
6. Same, the arm slightly drawn back. Face: focused.
7. Held pose: the arm still forward, palm up, the two fingers crooked in a slight "come here" curl; hair tips and the jacket hem still pulled slightly forward. Face: lazy smile.
8. The arm lowering, the right hand on its way back to the pocket. Face: lazy smile.
description: ANIMATION: "special", LAPSE: BLUE, a two-finger point that opens a gravity vortex in front of him. 8 frames in total, numbered 1 to 8 from left to right; this image is PART A of 2 and shows only poses 1 to 3. Poses 1 to 3 are the startup: no hit.

name: intro
poses: 1. Standing upright and tall, legs nearly straight, weight on the right leg (hip cocked), body turned toward the viewer (about 50 degrees), BOTH HANDS IN HIS POCKETS, chin raised, head tilted, looking down at the opponent on the right. Face: lazy cocky smile.
2. A loose shrug: shoulders rise slightly. Face: lazy smile.
